title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing adoption spreads and persists in a population over time under peer effects, policy, media messaging, and supply constraints.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: People observe mask use among their social contacts and update their adoption probability via threshold/contagion rules.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement_at_organization
interactions.description: Organizations enforce mask policies; people decide to comply, acquire masks, or avoid entry based on enforcement and penalties.

interactions.name: media_campaign_exposure
interactions.description: Media sources broadcast messages affecting risk perception and attitudes toward masking.

interactions.name: authority_policy_directive
interactions.description: PolicyAuthority issues guidance or mandates that set organization policies and penalties; influences person compliance.

interactions.name: mask_purchase
interactions.description: People buy masks from retailers if inventory is low and they intend to adopt or comply.

interactions.name: social_norms_and_sanctions
interactions.description: Individuals apply social pressure or experience social disapproval that changes perceived costs/benefits of masking.

metrics.name: overall_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Population share wearing masks consistently at each time step.

metrics.name: time_to_target_adoption
metrics.description: Days required to reach the target adoption rate threshold.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_by_group
metrics.description: Adoption rates stratified by age_group, income, or organization membership.

metrics.name: compliance_in_mandated_spaces
metrics.description: Share of people compliant with mask mandates when entering organizations with policies.

metrics.name: mask_supply_shortage_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of attempted purchases that fail due to insufficient retailer stock.

metrics.name: penalties_issued_per_day
metrics.description: Number and total value of penalties issued due to non-compliance.

metrics.name: message_reach
metrics.description: Proportion of population exposed to media or authority messages per period.

metrics.name: attitude_shift_index
metrics.description: Average change in risk perception or trust attributable to messaging and peer effects.

metrics.name: adoption_churn_rate
metrics.description: Rate at which individuals discontinue mask use after previously adopting.
